issues.description: The exercise describes and the template code reference an interface named 'Milkable' (with method messageOnMilk()). The solution implementation, however, introduces an interface named 'Dairy' that declares messageOnMilk(), and the file Milkable.java in the solution repository is empty. This naming mismatch (Milkable vs Dairy) means a student implementing the interface named 'Milkable' as required by the problem/template will not match the solution's 'Dairy' identifier and may encounter compilation or test integration problems or confusion about which interface to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution's interface 'Dairy' to 'Milkable' (update Dairy.java → Milkable.java with package and method: String messageOnMilk();), update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement Milkable, and remove the empty Milkable.java file or populate it accordingly. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to use 'Dairy' instead of 'Milkable'. Ensure all references (problem text, template code, and solution) use the same identifier so students know which interface to implement and tests compile consistently.
